pairs.old_short_title: Publish by pushing straight to the public remote
pairs.old_long_title: Releases are published by running git push to the public remote
pairs.old_details: To ship a change to users, push main directly to the public remote with git push.
pairs.new_long_title: Pushing to the public remote is forbidden outside the release script
pairs.new_details: A direct git push to the public remote bypasses vetting. Only the release script may publish; day-to-day work is pushed to the private remote only.

pairs.old_long_title: Service configuration is read from settings.ini
pairs.old_details: The service reads its configuration from settings.ini at the repo root.
pairs.new_long_title: Service configuration is read from config.toml; settings.ini is ignored
pairs.new_details: settings.ini was removed; the service reads config.toml and ignores any settings.ini.

tasks.wrong_belief: Changes are shipped to users by running git push to the public remote.
tasks.correction: Never git push to the public remote; only the release script publishes.
